process_issues.description: Every Bash call failed before running, including `gh pr view 219`, `gh pr view 219 --json reviews,comments`, `git diff --stat fde86d1e21ebf8afd2560349e289eb656941d31e..HEAD` and `git rev-parse HEAD`. Each one returned: `apply-seccomp: write /proc/self/setgroups (nested userns is capability-restricted; caller must provide CAP_SYS_ADMIN): Permission denied`. The bubblewrap sandbox cannot start on this runner because nested user namespaces are restricted, and dangerouslyDisableSandbox is disabled in this session.

No reviewers were spawned, so PR #219 was NOT reviewed. Without Bash there was no way to read the PR diff, its metadata or files, its review threads, or the head SHA. The working tree holds no diff artifact either. Reviewer subagents run in the same sandbox and need `gh pr diff` / `git diff` to see the change, so spawning them would have cost tokens and produced unfounded findings. Re-run once the runner allows the sandbox to start (unprivileged nested user namespaces / CAP_SYS_ADMIN for bwrap) or the sandbox is configured off for the review job.

incomplete_reason: Not reviewed: no reviewer was spawned; re-run
